findings.description: During stirring the rigid balls lose their spherical form and visibly overlap/fuse: at 00:07.50 two red balls appear merged into one elongated blob and at 00:06.75-00:07.25 and 00:09.25-00:09.75 balls stretch and interpenetrate neighbours (green and red masses blending into one another) rather than colliding as solid spheres. Motion blur explains some smearing but not balls occupying the same space.

At 00:09.00-00:09.25 the stirring fingers appear translucent and balls (red, yellow, green) show through and merge into the finger shapes instead of being pushed by them; finger outlines dissolve into ball surfaces, suggesting hand and balls passing through each other.

A yellow ball sits high on the steep inner wall of the bowl directly under the left fingertips, well above the other balls, without visible contact from either hand; at 00:09.25 a red ball is similarly suspended high under the left fingers. Could be a ball flung mid-bounce, so support violation is uncertain.
